exposure: use of faith healers before psychiatric consultation
outcome: association between psychiatric disorders and sociodemographic and birth characteristics
cohort: 207 patients under 18 years old who presented to the child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic in Erbil, Iraq
finding: The study found a variety of child and adolescent psychiatric disorders in Erbil, with significant associations between these disorders and factors such as socioeconomic status, parental education, consanguinity, and birth method.
mod_finding: 26.6% of the patients were born by caesarean section.
